decisions.reason: Reducing the displayed author-photo size does not change the requirement to include the author's name and photo.
The author-photo size change does not alter the required source of article content.
The source approves the overall direction while requesting a separate author-photo size adjustment; it does not change the polished, modern, brand-aligned style attributes.
The author-photo size adjustment does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
Changing the displayed dimensions of an author photo does not alter the requirement to enhance image quality when necessary.
The author-photo size adjustment does not change the deferred print-ready output, resolution, or prepress settings.
